name: jstack orchestrate
description: Shows pending decision gates and the frontier MR pipeline of jstack orchestrate programs.

statusBarItems.tooltip: jstack orchestrate: waiting for the first check

settings.title: Repo paths
settings.description: Absolute repo paths to scan, one per line. Each is read under .jstack/orchestrate/*/orca.json.

settings.title: orca path
settings.description: Leave empty to resolve orca from your login shell, falling back to /usr/local/bin/orca.

settings.title: glab path
settings.description: Leave empty to resolve glab from your login shell, falling back to /opt/homebrew/bin/glab.

settings.title: Interval (seconds)
settings.description: How often the worker reads every program. Minimum 5.
